Cuff, Nielsen and Miller Near Top
Ward Cuff and Walter "Horse" Nielsen, two outstanding members of the New York Giants
backfield, are among the top rank performers of the National Football League according to the
Nielsen has put on a terrific spurt in the race for ground gaining honors jumping from twelfth
to fifth in the league standing during the past week. Nielsen, rookie back, has gained 253 yards
despite the fact that he saw little service in the opening games. Nielsen is only 20 yards behind
Dick Todd, Washington ball toter, in fourth place. Top honors are held by Whizzer White of
Detroit with 366 yards, while Banks McFadden of Brooklyn has 326 yards and Parker Hall of the
Cleveland Rams is third with 308 yards. John Drake, another Ram back, is just one yard behind
Cuff is in the thick of the race to retain his field goal kicking honors and is also among the
leaders in the struggle for individual scoring honors. Cuff has kicked five field goals, one less
than Armand Nicolai of Pittsburgh, who has played two more games. Tied with Cuff however is
Clarke Hinkle, Green Bay fullback star who will face the Giants here next week. In the scoring
